name: PG&E Corporation

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (Pacific Gas and Electric Company logo.svg)

description: PG&E Corporation is the holding company of Pacific Gas and Electric Company, the Northern and Central California electric and natural gas utility, which accounts for essentially all of its revenue (the Corporation itself has 10 employees). The California Public Utilities Commission sets its revenue in General Rate Cases and a separate cost-of-capital proceeding (ROE 9.98% for 2026), while FERC sets transmission returns (base ROE 10.38%). 73.5% of 2025 revenue was electric and 26.5% gas. A large share of the electric and gas revenue only recovers pass-through power and gas purchase costs, so earnings come from the return on rate base, and wildfire liability (and the state Wildfire Fund that backs it) is the central risk to that return.

gics.note: Conventional filing label: GICS Sector 'Utilities', Sub-Industry 'Multi-Utilities' per Wikipedia 'List of S&P 500 companies' (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_S%26P_500_companies, read 2026-09-30); that list gives only Sector and Sub-Industry. SEC SIC code 4931 (Electric & Other Services Combined) per EDGAR.

employees.note: The Utility had approximately 29,000 regular employees, about 17,500 under collective bargaining; PG&E Corporation itself had 10 employees (FY2025 10-K)

businessLines.name: Electric operations (Pacific Gas and Electric Company)
businessLines.how: Customers pay monthly CPUC- and FERC-approved rates; the base-revenue requirement is set in the General Rate Case to recover costs plus a return on rate base (ROE 9.98%), and electricity procurement costs ($348M more revenue in 2025) are passed through with no effect on net income.
businessLines.description: Electric generation (hydroelectric system of 94 units at 58 powerhouses, two nuclear units at Diablo Canyon, solar and others), transmission and distribution in Northern and Central California.

businessLines.name: Natural gas operations (Pacific Gas and Electric Company)
businessLines.how: Regulated gas delivery rates under the GRC and gas transmission and storage proceedings plus pass-through of gas purchase costs.
businessLines.description: Gas distribution, transmission and storage in Northern and Central California.

brands.name: Pacific Gas and Electric Company (the Utility)
brands.share: Essentially 100% of operating revenue ($24,935M total FY2025); Utility income available for common stock $3,065M vs PG&E Corporation $2,593M

whatsNext.text: CPUC 2027 General Rate Case: the Utility asked for a $16.64B revenue requirement for 2027; proposed decision expected by March 2027, final decision by May 2027; interim rate recovery requested from May 2026
2026 cost of capital in effect: ROE 9.98%, cost of debt 5.04%
